questions.question: What disaster forms the backdrop of Jeremiah 14?
What does God say about the false prophets in Jeremiah 14?
options: They alone remain truly faithful among all of the people
They warn the people truly but no one at all will listen
They have all been carried far away into the exile
They prophesy lies in his name; he did not send them
questions.answer: They prophesy lies in his name; he did not send them

questions.question: Jeremiah confesses the people's sins and pleads with God not to abandon them for his name's sake.
The prophets are prophesying _____ in my name. I did not send them, declares the LORD.
We acknowledge our wickedness, O LORD, and the iniquity of our fathers, for we have _____ against you.
